description: Why do some people bloom from failure while others are shattered by it? Dweck's decades of research came down to two beliefs about ability — fixed and growth — and the different lives they build.

title: Norwegian Wood
author: a-murakami
description: Toru Watanabe hears a Beatles song on a plane and is thrown back to his student years in Tokyo: two women, one death, and the long business of learning to live with grief.
